title: VM-UNet: Vision Mamba UNet for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Pure visual-state-space (Mamba) asymmetric U-Net with ImageNet-pretrained VMamba weights, built for 2D.
adaptation: 1-channel stem, 512 px, PF fine-tune. Include as the pure-SSM family member of the EL benchmark suite.
min_experiment: One run per fold in the shared benchmark protocol; compared with the house model on test-49 crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2. Kill: below house on both, then keep only as a suite baseline.
evidence: R: DSC 89.03 ISIC17, 89.71 ISIC18, 81.08 Synapse. U-Bench reports the Mamba family as weaker on fine detail.

alt_notes.adaptation: Suite member; gray to 3 channels, 512 px, PF schedule. Patch-4 stem likely loses 1-2 px crack detail.
alt_notes.min_experiment: VM-UNet 5 folds v house PF; benchmark row; kill for score if CV crack relF1@2 < +0.01.
